data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2023 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 256.0m. During 2023 the Syndicate recognised a significant net favourable development on prior years (net prior-year release of approximately GBP 50.4m), driven primarily by favourable claims development and significant reinsurance-related movements (including legacy LPT/RITC effects), together with contained catastrophe experience and supportive investment performance. The release was broadly distributed across Property and Casualty portfolios, while newer exposures (Cyber, Energy) saw increases in gross outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2021 & prior year of account is closing by Reinsurance to close (RITC) after 36 months with a cumulative GAAP profit of GBP 45,413,000 (2020 & prior years of account - GBP 4,603,000) and a distributable profit of GBP 45,568,000.
Included within the 2022 balance above are GBP 43,400,000 of reinsurance recoveries in respect of the 2018 & prior legacy transaction.
The result for Syndicate 1492 for the year ended 31 December 2023 is a profit of GBP 53,296,000 (2022: GBP 30,093,000).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure derived from the underwriting year profit breakdown in the Directors' report (treated as the primary PYD indicator). No single explicit 'movement in prior year's provision' gross aggregate was provided; RITC/LPT activity (notably 2018 & prior LPT) materially affects comparability. Some LOB movements were inferred by comparing gross outstanding claims by class between 2022 and 2023.
